{{Quote|You call these bugs? Back on Danos V, they got sting insects the size of a house.|A [[Scout/Legends|scout]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>}}
'''Danos V''' was an astronomical body in the [[Danos system/Legends|Danos system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Shadola sector/Legends|Shadola sector]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> [[Sting insect]]s that were said to be large in comparison to other [[Insect/Legends|insects]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] could be found on Danos V.<ref name="TRG1" />
